$comment: Single source of truth for the G-reality SDF scene language (geometry AST). Consumed by the Python validator (greality_contracts.geometry), the TypeScript AST->GLSL compiler, the TypeScript CPU evaluator, and golden-vector tests. Units: meters, Y-up, right-handed. Changing semantics of an op requires bumping language_version.

param_types.quat: array of 4 finite floats (x, y, z, w), normalized by the compiler

ellipsoid.note: bound-corrected approximation (not exact distance); step scale 0.8

curve_tube.note: tube swept along the quadratic Bezier curve a -> c with control point b, radius interpolated from start to end; evaluated as 8 tapered segments (identical on GPU and CPU); step scale 0.95

superquadric.note: superellipsoid |x/a|^e + |y/b|^e + |z/c|^e = 1: e=2 ellipsoid, large e box-like/pillow, e<1 pinched star/crystal-like; approximate distance (field value times smallest radius), step scale 0.6

cone.note: capped cone / tapered cylinder, axis = +Y, centered

polyhedron.note: regular polyhedron centred at the origin, radius = inradius (centre to face); kind 0 tetrahedron, 1 cube, 2 octahedron, 3 dodecahedron, 4 icosahedron; generalized distance function max_i dot(p, n_i) - radius over the face normals (exact inside, a lower bound outside), step scale 1

scale.note: uniform only, distance multiplied by factor (keeps the SDF exact)

repeat.note: limited domain repetition: cell index clamped to [-count, count] per axis; count 0 disables that axis

radial_repeat.note: polar repetition about +Y; count rounded to integer; required offset in radians; isometric except sector borders, step scale 0.9

spiral_repeat.note: helical repetition about +Y: copy j (0 .. copies-1, rounded) of the child (placed at +X) is rotated by j * 2pi / count (count rounded) and raised by j * pitch / count, so pitch is the rise per full turn (pitch 0 with copies < count gives an arc); the copy nearest in angle and height is evaluated, step scale 0.8

taper.note: p.xz /= max(0.05, 1 + rate * p.y); positive rate widens upward; distance not rescaled; non-isometric, step scale 0.6

stretch.note: p /= factor; distance multiplied by minimum factor component (conservative bound); step scale 1

twist.note: radians per meter about +Y; non-isometric, step scale 0.6

bend.note: bend in XY; non-isometric, step scale 0.6

warp.note: domain offset by vector value-noise; step scale 0.7

displace.note: d + amplitude * fbm(p * frequency); step scale 0.7

noise.hash: Hoskins hash13 (no sin, stable across GPUs): p3 = fract(p * 0.1031); p3 += dot(p3, p3.zyx + 31.32); return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z); evaluated at p = lattice point + vec3(seed) * 17.0
noise.fbm: sum_{i<octaves} gain^i * (2*noise(p * lacunarity^i) - 1), lacunarity 2.0 and gain 0.5 unless stated
noise.tolerance: implementations (GLSL float32, TS float32 via Math.fround, PyTorch float32) must agree within 1e-3 on golden vectors in tests/golden/noise_v1.json
